7.4 Extended functionality
[SWS_ComM_00470] Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09071, SRS_ModeMgm_09157, SRS_ModeMgm_- 09089, SRS_ModeMgm_09155
⌈The extended functionality described in this chapter shall be individually configurable during runtime per feature (e.g. enable wake up inhibition but disable limitation to no communication).⌋ Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00470]: During runtime a change in the inhibition / limitation strategy is required in order to cope with changing conditions. Use Case: Change the wakeup inhibition via diagnostics. Comment: Configurable with parameter ComMEcuGroupClassification (see
[ECUC_ComM_00563]).
